visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair and bangs, wearing a black camisole and a gold necklace, stands in a lush outdoor garden. She is looking at a green plant and talking to it with an expressive, playful facial expression. The background features dense bamboo and greenery under natural daylight. (2) The camera zooms in to a close-up of a leaf on the plant. White circular graphic overlays appear on the screen briefly as if highlighting a specific point on the leaf. (3) The woman looks back at the plant with wide, startled eyes and an open mouth. She points towards the leaves with her hand, appearing surprised or excited. (4) Suddenly, a leaf seems to move towards her or touch her, causing her to flinch and jump back with a comical shocked expression, closing her eyes and mouth in a scream.
